description: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections. Credentials remain server-side, installed community packages are forked into the user's account, and saved workflows can run later without another model call. The same user-owned artifacts remain available across MCP-capable agents.

defaultPrompt: Turn this working API call into a reusable Kody package I own.
Remember this preference so every agent connected to my Kody account can use it.
Package this workflow and schedule it to run every weekday.
